whatItDoes: Calculates the tip for a restaurant bill or service, and splits the total among any number of people — showing the tip amount, total with tip, and per-person shares. You can adjust the tip percentage and party size to find the right split instantly.
whyItExists: Figuring a tip and splitting a bill by hand is error-prone and awkward. A quick calculator settles both instantly and fairly, whether it's an 18% dinner or a large group.
whoShouldUse: Diners, groups sharing a bill, and anyone leaving a gratuity for a service and wanting exact per-person totals.
useCases: Compute the tip on a restaurant bill
Split the total evenly among a group
Calculate a per-person share for a shared service
Quickly divide a group dinner bill with drinks and tax included
Check what a 15%, 18%, or 20% tip equals for a given amount
instructions: Enter the tip percentage you want to leave
Enter the number of people splitting the bill
Read the tip amount, total, and per-person share
Adjust the percentage to compare gratuity levels
Change the party size to recompute the split
examples: $100 bill, 18% tip, split 4 ways → tip $18, $29.50 each
$240 bill, 20% tip, split 3 ways → tip $48, $96 each
$85 bill, 15% tip, split 2 ways → tip $12.75, $48.88 each
$320 bill, 22% tip, split 5 ways → tip $70.40, $78.08 each
bestPractices: Use a tip rate that matches local norms
Round per-person amounts up if you prefer clean numbers
Include tax separately if that's your local practice
Ask how the bill is split if the group isn't equal
Decide the tip percentage before splitting to avoid confusion
commonMistakes: Tipping on the post-tax total when the norm is pre-tax
Forgetting to split the tip evenly across people
Entering the number of people as 0
Assuming the bill is split equally when someone had significantly more
faq: Does this tool support multiple currencies? — Yes, select your currency from the dropdown. All calculations run locally in your browser.
What tip percentage should I use? — Common ranges are 15-20%, depending on service and location.
Is the split always even? — This calculator splits evenly; adjust people if the group is unequal.
Does this include tax? — Only if you include tax in the bill amount.
Is my data shared? — No, everything runs locally in your browser.
Should I tip on the pre-tax or post-tax amount? — Customs vary; in the US, 15-20% of the pre-tax total is a common baseline.
Can I split unequally? — Not directly — enter only the people sharing equally, or compute each share separately.
features: Tip amount and total with tip
Even split across any group size
assumptions: Tip calculation is generic; tip percentage norms vary by country (US 15-20%, UK 10-15%, Japan 0%). User chooses appropriate rate.
